_hold_streak: polish1 item 168 (director: holding F for long periods DOES increase the chip count and can grow the account): while the launch key is held without letting go, chip payouts get a HOT STREAK bonus: none for after_s seconds, then rising evenly to top (x1.6) over ramp_s; letting go ends it. Return measured by tools/pachinko_check.gd (held line).
_about: The giant pachinko wall (game/pachinko_wall.gd, core/pachinko_sim.gd). Physics numbers as tuned in DECISIONS_CASINO.md. (polish1 item 75) 11 pockets: each pays pocket_multipliers x ball_cost chips; pocket_kinds: coin, miss, ticket (also tickets_per_pocket prize tickets), fever (the BONUS ROUND: fever.free_balls gold balls drop free around the marker), jackpot (pays its multiplier; every gold fever ball in it lights a jackpot lamp, jackpot.lamps lit in one fever wins the pachinko pot plus jackpot.tickets tickets; jackpot.share of every paid ball grows the pot, it restarts at jackpot.seed; saved per player). prizes = what prize tickets buy at the prize counter beside the console (gives tcg:<unopened item> or crate:<crate id>). Return measured with tools/pachinko_check.tscn.
_prizes: Ticket prices: a ticket comes about every 4 balls (40 chips staked, edges more, middle less), so one is worth ~13 chips at the vendors; prizes cost ~3x their chip price in stakes.
_return: Worked out 2026-11-20 (11 pockets, sweeping marker / held in the middle / at an edge): chips back 0.915 / 0.941 / 0.907 of the stake, counting the pot; jackpot about 1 in 640 / 480 / 1600 balls, pot ~520 on average; prize tickets 0.23 / 0.12 / 0.43 per ball.
